information:
While Food and Drinks are allowed at this venue, we ask that you please be curteous and clean up after yourself, or let one of the Organizers know if there is a spill that requires attention.

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
